CheckTitle: Entitlement management ensures catalog resources are governed by access packages
Description: Entitlement management **catalog resources** are evaluated to confirm every resource (group, application) is referenced by at least one access package via a `resourceRoleScope`. Resources present in a catalog but not used by any package are **delegated access surface with no business purpose** and are not covered by any access package policy or access review.
Risk: Adding a resource to a catalog delegates control to catalog owners and access package managers, who can grant membership or app roles to requestors **without owning** the underlying group or application. Unused resources widen the **delegated attack surface** without justification, violate **least privilege**, and represent **configuration drift** from deleted or modified packages.

Code.CLI: New-MgEntitlementManagementResourceRequest -BodyParameter @{ requestType = 'adminRemove'; resource = @{ originId = '<originId>'; originSystem = 'AadGroup' }; catalog = @{ id = '<catalogId>' } }
Code.Other:
1. Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center (https://entra.microsoft.com)
2. Go to ID Governance > Entitlement management > Catalogs
3. Select the catalog with unused resources
4. Navigate to Resources
5. Select each unused resource and click Remove (or add it to an access package if it is still needed)

Recommendation.Text: Review each entitlement management catalog and remove resources that are not referenced by any access package. If a resource is still needed, create or update an access package to include it. Apply the **principle of least privilege** by keeping catalogs lean and only delegating resources that are actively governed by access packages and their associated policies and access reviews.

Notes: SharePoint Online resources are not returned by GET /catalogs/{id}/resources with application permissions (documented Microsoft limitation) and are therefore not evaluated by this check. Requires EntitlementManagement.Read.All permission and Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Entra ID Governance license.
